# Net control

*Pages · 19 of 34*

Run a net: check-ins, traffic and a report.

## Starting

PKT → Net control. Name the net (the last name is remembered) and Start the net on the current channel. A clock shows how long it has run; the net keeps running if you close the sheet.

## Check-ins

Type a callsign and Check in, or tap one of the stations heard in the last 30 minutes (DMR callers with a RadioID callsign, APRS stations, Morse IDs; names come from the logbook). Stations checking in more than 15 minutes after the start are marked Late. Tap Traffic, Late or Out on a station to flag it; stations with traffic are highlighted. Long-press a station to remove it.

## Ending

End the net, then Share the report (name, channel, times, net control and the numbered check-ins with their flags) or Add to logbook to log every check-in as a contact. Past nets are listed under Net control; tap one for its report, long-press to delete it.
